div.div: 1 حَاتَ عَلَى الشَّىْءِ , aor. يَحُوتُ, (S,) inf. n. حَوْتٌ and حَوَتَانٌ, (K,) (assumed tropical:) He went, or circuited, round about the thing; said of a bird, (S, K, TA,) going, or circuiting, round about water [like a fish (حُوت) in water]; (TA;) and of a wild animal: (K:) as also حات بِهِ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
